info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Deliveries Status API provides insights into the current status of food delivery orders. This endpoint allows users to retrieve real-time updates regarding various deliveries, making it essential for delivery personnel, restaurant managers, and consumer-facing applications. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer experience by keeping all stakeholders informed about order statuses. Typical use cases include monitoring delivery performance and tracking responsiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to query the current status of deliveries in the system. It provides real-time information about delivery progress and helps in tracking packages effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to specify parameters needed to retrieve the delivery status. The included schema defines the data structure that must be adhered to when making the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of the deliveries.
